sources.title: Carry-over resolved: DeepSeek official Models & Pricing (V4.1-Flash + V4-Pro-0813)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Official Models & Pricing lists deepseek-flash (= DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) and deepseek-v4-pro (= DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813) with an explicit routing footnote: legacy deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp retired, served by V4.1-Flash at Flash price. This is the routing-cutover primary evidence W38 lacked.
claims.context: Official docs captured 2026-09-27; W38 primary gap resolved at docs level.

claims.text: Official rate card per 1M: flash cache-hit off-peak $0.003/peak $0.006, cache-miss $0.15/$0.3, output $0.6/$1.2; pro cache-hit $0.022/$0.044, cache-miss $0.66/$1.32, output $1.98/$3.96; off-peak half of peak with stated UTC windows; 1M context, 384K max output, concurrency 2500/500.
claims.context: Official rate card; production billing independently unverified.

claims.text: No V4.1-Pro model appears on the page; Pro remains V4-Pro-0813. The W38 no-claim boundary on V4.1-Pro launch/pricing/weight-retirement is preserved and now primary-backed.
